purpose: Continue the varied Tiny Tales queue after Rory with three non-repeating formats and the next compliant lead-voice rotation.

global_rules.narration_visual_sync: Every line and original effect begins and ends inside the composition that visibly depicts it.
global_rules.sound_policy: Visible machine, home and orchard sounds are locally performed or synthesized, never spoken as onomatopoeia.
global_rules.motion_hierarchy: One hero action, one supporting response layer and restrained ambient life.
global_rules.camera_rule: One eased camera intent per shot with cuts on musical phrases or completed actions.
global_rules.visual_quality: Premium original colourful 3D-style 16:9 scenes with clear focal hierarchy, depth and safe margins.

productions.title: Eddie Excavator's Rain-Garden Day | Construction Story for Kids
story_arc: Eddie reads a simple rain-garden plan while children watch safely behind a fence with a grown-up.
His working arm lowers, scoops and carries soil in clear mechanical steps.
He levels the curved basin and places stones while the children prepare native seedlings outside the work zone.
The grown-up confirms the machine is stopped before the planting team enters.
A gentle water test follows the downpipe into the finished rain garden instead of a muddy puddle.
